caption:

topic: MP Gazi Nazrul accused of abetting second wife's suicide
headline_marked: MP Gazi Nazrul [[placed on 4-day remand]] over second wife's death
headline: MP Gazi Nazrul placed on 4-day remand over second wife's death
summary: The lawmaker is accused of torturing his second wife, Mariam Khatun, and abetting her suicide. His parliamentary status is now under review.
details: Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife have been arrested in connection with the death of his second wife, Mariam Khatun.
A court has ordered a 4-day police remand for the MP, following allegations of torture and abetting the suicide of the second wife.
The victim's body was found hanging in the NYAM building, leading to a case of abetment to suicide.
The Election Commission (EC) is currently awaiting a formal letter from the Parliament Secretariat regarding the lawmaker's status.
The EC Secretary stated that the seat will be declared vacant if the MP is not present in Parliament for 90 consecutive days without permission.
Mariam's father has spoken out about her condition before her death, stating she would barely respond when he tried to talk to her.
The investigation is ongoing to determine the exact circumstances surrounding Mariam Khatun's death.
caption:
An MP and his first wife arrested for abetting suicide. Now, a court has placed the lawmaker on a 4-day remand.

Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife have been arrested in connection with the death of his second wife, Mariam Khatun.

A court has ordered a 4-day police remand for the MP, following allegations of torture and abetting the suicide of the second wife.

The victim's body was found hanging in the NYAM building, leading to a case of abetment to suicide.

The Election Commission (EC) is currently awaiting a formal letter from the Parliament Secretariat regarding the lawmaker's status.

The EC Secretary stated that the seat will be declared vacant if the MP is not present in Parliament for 90 consecutive days without permission.

Mariam's father has spoken out about her condition before her death, stating she would barely respond when he tried to talk to her.

The investigation is ongoing to determine the exact circumstances surrounding Mariam Khatun's death.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
